name: Chicken & chorizo rice pot
assumptions: Yield estimated at 4 adult servings based on total quantities (1.2 kg chicken + 400 g rice + 800 ml stock is typical for 4 portions in a one-pot rice casserole).

Total active and passive time summed from instructions: ~3 min browning + 13 min sofrito + 1 min puree + 30 min simmer + 15 min rice + 10 min rest + ~6 min estimated prep = 78 min; prep time conservatively included as not separately stated.
Oil conservatively classified as generic (could be olive/vegetable); no dairy, gluten, or top allergens introduced.

Chicken stock and chorizo classified as potentially containing trace wheat/soy (common in commercial stock cubes or sausage casings/seasonings) hence null for Wheat/Soy; no fish/shellfish ingredients listed so null.
Thyme, parsley, tomato puree, wine, garlic, onion, pepper classified as allergen-free.
No barley/rye/wheat/oats listed so Gluten-free is null (stock/chorizo could introduce gluten).
Dairy-free confirmed true: no milk, butter, cheese or dairy-derived items present.
instructions:
step 1
Heat the oil in a large flameproof casserole dish and brown the chicken pieces on all sides – you may have to do this in batches. Remove from the dish and put to one side.

step 2
Lower the heat, add the onion and pepper, and gently cook for 10 mins until softened. Add the garlic and chorizo, and cook for a further 2 mins until the chorizo has released some of its oils into the dish. Stir in the tomato purée and cook for 1 min more.

step 3
Return the chicken pieces to the dish along with the thyme, white wine and stock. Bring the liquid to a boil, cover the dish with a tight-fitting lid and lower the heat. Cook for 30 mins.

step 4
Tip in the rice and stir everything together. Cover, set over a low heat and cook for a further 15 mins, or until the rice is cooked and has absorbed most of the cooking liquid. Remove from the heat and leave the dish to sit for 10 mins to absorb any remaining liquid. Season to taste and scatter with parsley to serve.

ingredients.name: Oil
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tbsp olive oil (typical for Spanish recipes; assumed olive as common in cuisine)

ingredients.name: Chicken
ingredients.assumptions: 1 whole chicken estimated at 1.2kg raw edible yield (meat + skin, typical medium bird for casserole); raw state as added early in recipe

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.assumptions: 1 large onion, typical 150g raw chopped weight

ingredients.name: Red Pepper
ingredients.assumptions: 1 medium-large red bell pepper, typical 120g raw chopped weight

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.assumptions: 3 average garlic cloves, total ~9g raw crushed

ingredients.name: Chorizo
ingredients.assumptions: 225g chorizo sausage as specified; cured/ready-to-eat type typical for Spanish dish

ingredients.name: Thyme
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tbsp chopped fresh thyme leaves, typical 4g (herb weight is low but nutrient-dense)

ingredients.name: White Wine
ingredients.assumptions: 150ml dry white wine (density ~1g/ml; alcohol contributes to calories)

ingredients.name: Chicken Stock
ingredients.assumptions: 800ml chicken stock, typical low-sodium prepared stock (density ~1g/ml)

ingredients.name: Rice
ingredients.assumptions: 400g uncooked white long-grain rice (typical for Spanish rice pot); raw/dry weight as added to absorb liquid

ingredients.name: Parsley
ingredients.assumptions: 2 tbsp chopped fresh parsley, typical 8g total (herb weight is low but nutrient-dense)
